```{r}
make_ids_unique <- function(ids) {
  dup_ids <- ids[duplicated(ids) | duplicated(ids, fromLast = TRUE)]
  unique_dup_ids <- unique(dup_ids)
  for (id in unique_dup_ids) {
    suffix <- 1
    indices <- which(ids == id)
    for (index in indices) {
      ids[index] <- paste0(ids[index], ".", suffix)
      suffix <- suffix + 1
    }
  }
  return(ids)
}
```

```{r}
custom_simulate <- function(i, plasmode.data, analytic.data, demovars, lab.list, proxy.list.arg, nSim, intermediate_dir) { # Changed proxy.list to proxy.list.arg for clarity
  # 1. Correctly name the ID column in the 'x' data.frame for the join
  df_for_join <- data.frame(id = plasmode.data[, i],    # Name this column 'id'
                            EVENT = plasmode.data[, i + nSim])
  
  plasmodeData.i <- plyr::join(x = df_for_join,
                               y = analytic.data, # This is full.data
                               by = "id",         # Now 'id' exists in df_for_join
                               type = "left")

  # 2. Add checks to ensure the join worked as expected (optional but good practice)
  if (nrow(plasmodeData.i) != nrow(df_for_join)) {
    warning(paste("Join for simulation", i, "resulted in different row count than expected (", nrow(plasmodeData.i), "vs", nrow(df_for_join),"). Check 'by' variable and data integrity."))
  }
  if (any(is.na(plasmodeData.i$id))) { # IDs should not become NA after a left join on x's key
    warning(paste("NA values found in 'id' column after join for iteration", i, ". This is unexpected. Review join logic."))
  }
  # Example: check if a crucial column from analytic.data that should always be present is NA
  # if ("some_critical_col_from_analytic_data" %in% names(plasmodeData.i) && any(is.na(plasmodeData.i$"some_critical_col_from_analytic_data"))) {
  #   warning(paste("Iteration", i, ": NAs found in a critical joined column. Join may not have matched as expected."))
  # }


  plasmodeData.i$outcome <- plasmodeData.i$EVENT # This assumes EVENT from df_for_join.
                                                 # If analytic.data also has an EVENT column, plyr::join might rename them
                                                 # (e.g., EVENT.x, EVENT.y). Be explicit if needed:
                                                 # If EVENT.x is from df_for_join: plasmodeData.i$outcome <- plasmodeData.i$EVENT.x
                                                 # It's often safer to rename columns before join to avoid clashes, e.g.:
                                                 # df_for_join <- data.frame(id = plasmode.data[,i], current_event_simulated = plasmode.data[,i + nSim])
                                                 # ... then later: plasmodeData.i$outcome <- plasmodeData.i$current_event_simulated

  plasmodeData.i$EVENT <- NULL # This will remove the EVENT column. If it was renamed (e.g. EVENT.x), specify that.
  
  # Ensure the 'id' column used by make_ids_unique is the one you intend.
  # After the join, plasmodeData.i$id is the correct column.
  plasmodeData.i$id <- make_ids_unique(plasmodeData.i$id) 
  
  saveRDS(plasmodeData.i, file = paste0(intermediate_dir, "/data_", i, ".rds"))
  return(plasmodeData.i)
}
```


```{r}
nSim <- 1000
# Initialize the cluster
no_cores <- detectCores() - 2
cl <- makeCluster(no_cores)
print(paste("Number of cores:", no_cores))

# Export necessary variables and functions to the cluster
clusterExport(cl, varlist = c("custom_simulate", "simdata", "full.data",
                              "demovars", "labvars.original",
                              "proxy.list", "nSim",
                              "make_ids_unique", "intermediate_dir"))

# Load necessary libraries on each worker node
clusterEvalQ(cl, {
  library(dplyr)
  library(Plasmode)
  library(plyr)
})

# Use pbapply to run the simulations in parallel with a progress bar
results <- tryCatch({
  pblapply(1:nSim, function(i) {
    custom_simulate(i, simdata, full.data, demovars, labvars.original, proxy.list, nSim, intermediate_dir)
  }, cl = cl)
}, error = function(e) {
  print(paste("Error in parLapply:", e))
  stopCluster(cl)  # Ensure the cluster is stopped in case of error
  NULL
})

# Stop the cluster
stopCluster(cl)

print("Simulation completed.")
```
